remarks: This spacious freshly painted 2 bedroom condo is one of the most sought after downtown locations within easy walking distance to everything in vibrant downtown Stamford. Enjoy popular Latham Park located directly across the street or take a leisure walk to restaurants, library, theaters, shopping, seasonal farm and transportation. Open floor plan, hardwood floor throughout and kitchen with ample light oak cabinetry, granite countertop and gas range. Bathroom with a new vanity. Plenty of closets, private oversized 11X6 balcony with great city views. This condo is located in a well maintained and managed, secured downtown building with bright laundry facilities and a storage on main level with a live in superintendent on site. Heat and hot water and cooking gas included in rent. Reserved off street parking #40. Excellent Credit and References Required.
